title: Orvan grain ships turn back as corridor deal lapses

facts.subject: Orvan grain corridor agreement
facts.statement: Orvan's one-year grain corridor agreement ended on 10 September with no renewal, and the first ships due to load have been held outside Orvan Grain Port.

source_ref.text_snippet: Orvan's one-year grain corridor agreement ended on 10 September with no renewal, and the first ships due to load have been held outside Orvan Grain Port.

facts.subject: Orvan grain shipments
facts.statement: We have no cover for next month and no clear rule for the ships already booked, said Leif Garrow, who leads the Orvan farm union.

source_ref.text_snippet: "We have no cover for next month and no clear rule for the ships already booked," said Leif Garrow, who leads the Orvan farm union.

facts.subject: Orvan grain shipments
facts.statement: Several ships that had been waiting outside the harbour were still there at dusk, and a queue of grain trucks formed at the landward gate.

source_ref.text_snippet: Several ships that had been waiting outside the harbour were still there at dusk, and a queue of grain trucks formed at the landward gate.

facts.subject: Orvan grain shipments
facts.statement: The ministry's notice on the lapse was short and gave no estimate of the volume affected.

source_ref.text_snippet: The ministry's notice on the lapse was short and gave no estimate of the volume affected.

facts.subject: Wheat offers
facts.statement: Wheat offers for later delivery firmed in early trade, though volumes were thin.
